name: CKEditor5 Mentions
description: The mention feature enables smart autocompletion based on user input. When you type a pre-configured marker, such as @ or #, a panel displays with autocomplete suggestions.
project_description: CKEditor 5 Mentions adds @/#-style mention autocompletion to Drupal's CKEditor 5. A `mention_feed` config entity defines a trigger marker (e.g. @, #, +), a target entity type/bundle to search, and an optional list of static feed items. When an editor types the marker in a CKEditor 5 field, a JavaScript integration queries a JSON endpoint that returns matching entity labels for a dropdown. The module ships a CKEditor 5 configurable plugin (Mentions Configuration) that lets each text format enable specific feeds and set a dropdown limit, plus an admin UI at /admin/config/content/mention-feed for managing feeds. Two permissions gate the feature: 'mention users' (who may use mentions and hit the autocomplete endpoint) and 'to be mentioned' (a per-user opt-in). Mentions are stored as inline <span class="mention" data-mention> markup allowed by the text format.
